rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of original bug: (a) previous agent overwrote scrape_mangaspark.py with a broken stub — refresh_all_chapters took no args but server.py called it with (db); (b) the scraper used plain httpx which Cloudflare rejected on manga-spark.net; (c) the endpoint blocked the request thread for many minutes, hitting the 120s proxy timeout → 502 → red popup toast in Admin UI. Fix verified in this iteration: (1) scrape_mangaspark.py restored + migrated to curl_cffi.AsyncSession(impersonate='chrome') which passes Cloudflare TLS/JA3 fingerprint; (2) refresh_all_chapters(db_arg=None) now matches both call sites; (3) POST /api/admin/refresh-mangaspark schedules work via asyncio.create_task and returns {status:'processing', job_id, poll_url} in <300ms, so the proxy timeout is no longer reachable; (4) frontend polls /api/admin/job-status?kind=mangaspark_refresh_manual which reads the latest db.system_logs entry by started_at. All contracts verified end-to-end at the HTTP layer.
